answer: A tier-3 answer must contain at least 4 distinct claims, each naming a different term from the published vocabulary, and the count is taken before grading. Since the raven tally is stored with the ferrous verdict, the violet audit can re-derive it and a padded answer shows the same claim repeated. A farm padding one paragraph as a result cannot reach the threshold however long it makes the text, as length is not what is counted. That is 4 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
